name: The Imperium
closingLine: The fog has lifted from every field and every tower. Long may you reign.

provinces.name: The Marches
provinces.flavour: The fields are yours. Past the last fence, the gulls are calling.

provinces.name: The Coast
provinces.flavour: The harbours fly your banner. Inland, the old trees close ranks.

provinces.name: The Wildwood
provinces.flavour: The old trees bow to you. Beyond them, the mountains ring with hammers.

provinces.name: The Forge
provinces.flavour: The forges burn in your name. Below the passes, the city walls catch the light.

provinces.name: The Capital
provinces.flavour: The streets cheer your name. At their heart, the palace doors stand open.

provinces.name: The Throne
provinces.flavour: The crown is yours. From the last fence of the Marches to this seat, the Imperium kneels.
